name: Time is Money [STEAL]
desc:
💰 Time is Money [STEAL]

❗ NEW UPDATE: CANDYLAND + R6 ❗

Every second counts. Every kill pays.

Earn cash just by staying alive — but the moment you die, everything goes to your killer. Bank your money in the Safe Zone to keep it safe, or risk it all chasing bigger multipliers across the map.

🗡️ Kill players to steal their cash
🏦 Bank your earnings before you lose them
⚡ Stand on multiplier pads for bonus income
🎲 Open cases to unlock powerful cash multipliers
🔒 Unlock new areas with bigger rewards

The longer you survive, the richer you get — but the richer you get, the bigger the target on your back.

Can you make it to the top of the leaderboard, or will someone steal it all first?

---

🎮 Full Xbox controller support
👑 Persistent leaderboards — your stats save forever
🔄 Regular updates coming
